# Spot moodboard

> An interactive moodboard for Spot, a two-year-old black labrador with a red collar. 40 pictures (mostly AI-generated portraits made from photos of him, plus screenshots from his games) in three looks: a cork pinboard where you can drag the pictures around, a clean gallery, and a cozy Christmas wall with falling snow. One static index.html, no build step. MIT licence for the code; the pictures are not MIT.

- Filters: Cozy, Festive, Studio, Art, Games. Shuffle, Tidy up, zoom on the pinboard.
- Each picture opens in a lightbox with its five main colours; click a colour to copy its hex code.
- Nothing is uploaded. The look, filter and pinboard positions are kept in localStorage.
